instrumentation.trigger: runTime.value() == 0.003 within 1e-12; mapped call is located only after mesh_.update(), and other stages are guarded to capture one outer iteration
instrumentation.fields: Cell CSV: C,V,U,p. Face CSV: owner,neighbour,Cf,Sf,phi,Uf.
instrumentation.source_to_binary_equivalence: NOT_ESTABLISHED; instrumented incompressibleFluid module is built from pinned source and loaded ahead of the packaged module, while other runtime libraries come from the pinned image.

comparisons: Stage-to-stage cellwise U, p, face phi and Uf differences on identical topology
Volume-weighted cell-centre velocity error against exact MMS at the corresponding physical state time
Mapped U versus independent parent-value transfer from the archived t=0.002 AMR state
Final instrumented state versus frozen uninstrumented control
analysis.acceptance: Require exactly five stage snapshots, matching topology across stages, successful solver completion, and agreement of instrumented final state with the frozen uninstrumented control before interpreting stage attribution. No numerical quality threshold is introduced.

limitations: One n=16 first-refinement event is a mechanism diagnostic, not a convergence or production-quality study.
The v1 attempt completed the solver but failed the event-count gate: mapped was absent and repeated PIMPLE captures produced 12 events. Its raw logs and partial evidence are preserved.
The packaged Foundation binary is not proven equivalent to all inspected upstream source, even though this module is compiled from the pinned source commit.
Any separated change identifies where this run changes, not a general solver defect or physical singularity.
